Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 127. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 melee technique
Ki Cost: 30 Ki
Prerequisites: Wolf Fang Fist
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Melee
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
A rapid flurry of jabs and kicks designed to mimic the
ferocity of a desert wolf. Make 4 Combo attack rolls
dealing 1d8 damage for each attack. At the resolution of
this technique the target gets knocked back 5 feet for
each Combo attack roll that landed.
